newsitem.title: UK: Visa used for record $1 trillion sales in year.
newsitem.headline: Visa used for record $1 trillion sales in year.

text.p: Visa International, the world's biggest consumer payments system, said Monday its cards were used to buy a record $1 trillion in goods and services in the year ended March 31.
The total was 24 percent higher than the $824 billion of purchases seen in the previous year.
Visa said that debit cards, which transfer money directly from a customer's bank account, rather than credit cards, which draw on a credit line, are the fastest growing part of its business.

Debit card transactions grew 40 percent to $305 billion with a total of 119 million cards in use, a rise of 36.7 percent. Total Visa cards in issue rose by 12.8 percent, with 572 million cards in use.
